title: Orphans of Qingyun
summary: Zhang Xiaofan and Lin Jingyu find their parents and their whole village dead. Xiao Yicai brings them up to the Qingyun Sect, where the Water Qilin, tamed by Master Qingye a thousand years ago, roars at them. Sect leader Dao Xuan reports that all 42 households of Grass Temple Village were killed and only three people survived. Questioned, Lin Jingyu says they woke under the tree at the village entrance, and Xiaofan stays silent to keep his promise to Pu Zhi. The peak masters argue over the boys: Cang Song gets Lin Jingyu for Dragon Head Peak, and Xiaofan goes to Tian Buyi's Great Bamboo Peak, which has only seven disciples. Song Daren takes Xiaofan home, Tian Ling'er stops the brothers from teasing him, and Tian Buyi and his wife welcome him over dinner. Xiaofan meets the dog Dahuang, practises Pu Zhi's method at night, and starts the peak's rule for new disciples: cutting the hard black bamboo every day.
